title: Average visible Earth fraction
description: Time-average of Earth's centre being above the local LOLA terrain horizon (direct-to-Earth line of sight).
method: LOLA LDEM_64 horizons ray-marched on the 1737.4 km sphere (72 azimuths, observer 2 m, 0.5-300 km, only the azimuths Earth crosses) + SPICE DE440 Earth vector in MOON_ME, LT+S, with parallax; hour-by-hour comparison, cells decided early when libration bounds make the answer certain.

sources.name: LOLA LDEM_64
sources.citation: Smith et al. (2010), LOLA GDR, NASA PDS Geosciences Node

sources.name: NAIF SPICE DE440
sources.citation: Park et al. (2021), AJ 161:105; moon_pa_de440_200625.bpc, moon_de440_250416.tf
